question: Hello, Odacchi! I've been wondering for a long time now, when and where did Luffy first learn the term "Pirate King"?
answer: He learned about it from Shanks' stories. Of course, Shanks didn't tell him that he used to be on the Pirate King's ship. Before meeting Shanks, Garp had told him to become a Marine, but since he wanted to be able to adventure freely, Luffy was already somewhat resistant to the idea.
name: Masazou
